text: Entry 904 removes addThisServer parsing from autoconfig XML and labels the AccountConfig field as internal. The factory still defaults it to true; XML may set useGlobalPreferredServer. The manual outgoing form clears reuse choices for a custom server without unconditionally overriding addThisServer. Do not restore a provider-controlled addThisServer field when extending remote schemas. Current tests read ordinary XML configurations, but no explicit hostile addThisServer override test was inspected.
title: Keep internal outgoing-server creation flags outside remote XML configuration
